title: Poppy Company, multi-state Form 940 with Schedule A credit reduction

status.note: Composed offline and schema-valid against the 2026v2.0 bundle (AtsScenarioComposeTest).

summary: A multi-state employer (NY and VI) that paid wages in a credit-reduction state. $100,000 of retirement/pension payments are exempt, leaving $250,000 of taxable FUTA wages. Schedule A applies the Virgin Islands 0.045 credit reduction ($11,250), which raises the tax to $12,750. The $250 overpayment is applied to the next return.
tests: Line 1b multi-state and line 2 credit-reduction checkboxes, both pointing to Schedule A
Line 4 exempt payments with only 4c (retirement/pension) checked
Schedule A: NY checked with no amounts, VI with wages x 0.045 = 11250.00
Line 11 equals the Schedule A total; line 12 = 1500.00 + 11250.00
notes: Schedule A is one CreditReductionGrp per checked state (NY bare, VI with wages, rate and reduction), as IRS940ScheduleA.xsd defines it. F940-001-02 needs at least two FUTAStateCd entries when line 1b is checked.
Schedule A requires TotalCreditReductionWagesAmt, which the paper form has no box for. It is 250000.00, the VI FUTA taxable wages (SA-F940-002-02: not above line 7).
Line 4 is ExemptWagesAmt followed by RetirementPensionInd (line 4c), in schema order. Line 6 is TotalExemptWagesAmt (line 4 + line 5).

Lines 1b and 2 are MultiStateInd and CreditReductionStateInd, each referencing IRS940ScheduleA. Line 11 is TotalCreditReductionAmt and equals Schedule A (F940-010, SA-F940-007-01). Line 15b is ApplyOverpaymentNextReturnInd.
No balance due and no requested payment date, so no payment record.
Responsible Party Current Indicator: Yes (PDF p.1). The composer's constant IRSResponsiblePrtyInfoCurrInd=true matches.
Signature Option: 'Use the signature method applicable to you' (PDF p.1). Part 7 is blank; Pyramos signs with ReportingAgentPINGrp.

Part 6 third-party designee: neither Yes nor No is checked and no designee is named (form page 2). The composer's DiscussWithThirdPartyNoInd=X is the only consistent header choice, since no designee exists to report.
Amounts are written with cents (200000.00), as the PDF prints them (USDecimalAmountNNType).
